information: ### Davis' first ever competition featuring *blindfolded events*, *fewest moves*, and *clock* - Don't DNF! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTMyODc3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--43a4741aef31f26a98dc1e8b9ffd2345e0737df2/image.png) ##### This competition will be specializing in quiet events and will not have 3x3 or typical events found in traditional competitions. *New competitors are welcome — for Clock solvers, we highly encourage you to explore and take on the challenge of blindfolded and fewest moves!* - All attendees under the age of 18 are required to be accompanied by a parent or guardian. - Competition attendees may **appear on livestream and media**. - Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called. **This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [Speedcubeshop](https://speedcubeshop.com/).** ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png)
